paper_title: Guided Search Strategies in Non-Serializable Environments with   Applications to Software Engineering Agents
caption: : Critic learns to distinguish successful and unsuccessful trajectories for GPT-4o.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between time and average critic score for different policies. The x-axis is labeled “Time (relative)” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled “Average critic score” with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. 

The first line, colored green and solid, represents “GPT-4o policy, successful” and begins at approximately 0.31 at time 0.0, rises to 0.55 at time 0.4, then continues to increase, reaching 0.77 at time 0.8.

The second line, colored red and dashed, represents “GPT-4o policy, unsuccessful” and begins at approximately 0.29 at time 0.0, decreases to 0.21 at time 0.2, and gradually increases to 0.36 at time 0.8. 

The third line, colored green and dash-dotted, represents “GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, successful” and starts at approximately 0.48 at time 0.0, decreases to 0.44 at time 0.2, and increases to 0.64 at time 0.4, and continues to rise reaching 0.79 at time 0.8. 

The fourth line, colored red and dotted, represents “GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, unsuccessful” and begins at approximately 0.24 at time 0.0 and maintains a roughly constant value around 0.23 to 0.28 until time 0.8, where it rises to 0.33.
